display_name: Snapdeal formula pattern — Monthly Settlement Summary
formula_sql:
SELECT
  settlement_date,
  settlement_id,
  SUM(charged_amount) AS gross_gmv,
  SUM(settled_amount) AS net_settled,
  SUM(commission) AS commission,
  COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_number) AS invoices
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement
WHERE is_active = true
  AND transaction_type IN ('forward', 'reverse')
GROUP BY settlement_date, settlement_id
ORDER BY settlement_date;
